stem.en: Which set of features fits a wind-pollinated flower?

text.en: Large spiny pollen, sticky stigma, bright petals

feedback.en: These features fit an insect-pollinated flower.

text.en: Few sticky grains, a short stigma, strong scent

feedback.en: Sticky grains and scent suit visitors. Wind needs many light grains.

text.en: Light small pollen, long feathery stigma

feedback.en: Yes. Light grains travel on the wind and a feathery stigma traps them.

text.en: Heavy wet pollen, a closed stigma, rich nectar

feedback.en: Wind could not lift heavy grains, and nectar is for visitors.

explanation.en: Wind-pollinated flowers such as maize produce light, small pollen in large numbers. A long, feathery stigma traps it from the air.

hints.en: What kind of grain can the wind lift?
What shape of stigma catches grains from moving air?
